title: Decision
description: A record of a choice made by the system (or the team that built it): what was chosen, what was rejected, and why.

actor.description: Who or what made this decision, e.g. 'encounter_agent:v1'.

choice.description: What was decided, in plain language.

reasoning.description: Why this choice was made over the alternatives.

facts_touched.description: IDs of the Facts this decision read or wrote.

parent_decision_id.description: ID of the Decision this one follows from, if any. Lets a chain of decisions be walked backward.
